environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster with migration-service deployed in namespace 'platform-tools'. Istio service mesh with STRICT mTLS enforced cluster-wide via PeerAuthentication. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied in the 'platform-tools' namespace with spec.action DENY for requests where source.namespace is NOT in ['platform-tools'] combined with a second AuthorizationPolicy with ALLOW action requiring source.principal matching 'cluster.local/ns/platform-tools/sa/migration-controller'. The DENY policy uses a 'notValues' selector on source.namespaces field. Additionally, a Sidecar resource in platform-tools restricts egress to './*' and 'istio-system/*' only. Note: the threading.Lock in the code is process-local and does not protect against concurrent requests hitting separate Gunicorn workers, but the authorization layer ensures only the single migration-controller ServiceAccount (which serializes requests via its own queue) can invoke the endpoint.
